BLUE DOLPHIN REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

 

 

● Total gross profit of $26.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and $72.1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

● Net income of $18.9 million, or income of $1.27 per share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and net income of $51.4 million, or income of $3.44 per share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

● Consolidated earnings before interest, income taxes, depreciation, and amortization (“EBITDA”) of $25.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and consolidated EBITDA of $70.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

● Refinery operations EBITDA of $23.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and refinery operations EBITDA of $67.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

 

HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 16, 2026 / Blue Dolphin Energy Company ("Blue Dolphin") (OTCQX:BDCO), an independent refiner and marketer of petroleum products in the Eagle Ford Shale region, announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

 

Results of Operations

 

Three Month Periods

Blue Dolphin reported total gross profit of $26.5 million and net income of $18.9 million, or income of $1.27 per share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Comparatively, Blue Dolphin reported a total gross profit of less than $0.1 million and a net loss of $4.7 million, or a loss of $0.31 per share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Consolidated EBITDA totaled $25.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to consolidated EBITDA of $(4.4) million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

 

For the three months ended September 30, 2026, refinery operations income before income taxes totaled $23.1 million compared to a refinery operations loss before income taxes of $2.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Refinery operations EBITDA totaled $23.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to refinery operations EBITDA of $(1.5) million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

 

Nine Month Periods

Blue Dolphin reported total gross profit of $72.1 million and net income of $51.4 million, or income of $3.44 per share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Comparatively, Blue Dolphin reported total gross profit of $6.7 million and a net loss of $4.1 million, or a loss of $0.28 per share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Consolidated EBITDA totaled $70.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to consolidated EBITDA of $0.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

 

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, refinery operations income before income taxes totaled $64.1 million compared to a refinery operations loss before income taxes of $(0.4) million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.  Refinery operations EBITDA totaled $67.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to refinery operations EBITDA of $2.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

 

"Blue Dolphin delivered another quarter of strong operational and financial performance by capitalizing on market opportunities," said Jonathan P. Carroll, Chief Executive Officer of Blue Dolphin Energy Company. "We remain focused on safe, reliable operations, margin capture, capital discipline, and value creation while enhancing refining capacity and capabilities."

 

Liquidity

 

Cash and cash equivalents totaled $40.8 million and $1.0 million as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively, representing a $39.8 million improvement. Blue Dolphin generated $54.4 million in cash flow from operations during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to using $2.5 million in cash flow from operations during the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The $56.9 million increase in cash flow provided by operations between the periods was primarily due to more favorable gross margins from the refining segment in 2026. 

 

For more information regarding Blue Dolphin's financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, see Blue Dolphin's Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q as filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 16, 2026.

About Blue Dolphin

 

Blue Dolphin is an independent downstream energy company operating in the Gulf Coast region of the United States. Subsidiaries operate a light, sweet-crude, 15,000-barrel per day crude distillation tower with over 1.25 million barrels of petroleum storage tank capacity in Nixon, Texas. Blue Dolphin formed in 1986 as a Delaware corporation and trades on the OTCQX under the ticker symbol “BDCO.” For additional information, visit Blue Dolphin's corporate website at http://www.blue-dolphin-energy.com.
